scope: An additive v3 operation schema, finite compact wire and reviewed prompt projection. No new remote model/provider calls.
implemented: Legacy default operation types and known-city enumeration remain unchanged; opt-in adds only trusted snapshot names and finite reference IDs.
Optional nullable place_id for origin/stay edits and end_place_id for route endpoint; existing domain remains authority for exact city/reference relations.

resolve_place is a non-mutating request: target_id required null; role origin/destination/route_end; kind country/city; query2..160; optional nullable ISO2; destination stay_id requires exact owned/new alias and other roles require null.
No CityRefSnapshot, coordinates or provider identifiers can be emitted in operation values.
V3 reuses exact finite type/target selector codebooks; unknown selectors, duplicate JSON keys, NaN, malformed Unicode and bounded structure failures remain rejected.

The v3 hints verifier rebuilds the entire expected schema from a trusted trip, checks exact schema equality and a reviewed resolve grammar fingerprint, removes only validated additive fields/query variant, then reuses the unchanged legacy value grammar and city-enum verifier.
V3 wrappers are appended after the full untouched old transport source; default v1/v2 behavior and separate readonly role remain intact.
limits: Trusted_state provenance must already be verified by API/Store/Catalog; structural schema and hints do not authenticate a client-supplied snapshot.
Provider/config/harness opt-in integration is owned by root and is not qualified by these pure tests.
resolve_place is deliberately rejected by apply_operations; the harness must resolve, clarify and convert a selected verified result into a separate owned domain edit.
No global actual NLU/search/availability or tariff result is claimed.
The hint text is guidance, not equivalent JSON Schema; the original full canonical schema and domain checks remain mandatory.
Default legacy models/profiles are not silently switched to dynamic geography.
